verses.raw: And never think of those who have been killed in the cause of Allāh as dead. Rather, they are alive with their Lord, receiving provision,
verses.text: And never think of those who have been killed in the cause of Allāh as dead. Rather, they are alive with their Lord, receiving provision,

verses.raw: Rejoicing in what Allāh has bestowed upon them of His bounty, and they receive good tidings about those [to be martyred] after them who have not yet joined them - that there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
